  (h₀ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c)
  (h₁ : 3 ≤ a * b + b * c + c * a) :
  3 / Real.sqrt 2 ≤ a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a) := by

  have h₃ : 0 < b := h₀.2.1
  have h₄ : 0 < c := h₀.2.2
  have h₅ : 0 < a + b := by linarith
  have h₆ : 0 < b + c := by linarith
  have h₇ : 0 < c + a := by linarith
  have h₈ : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have h₉ : 0 < Real.sqrt (a + b) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₅
  have h₁₀ : 0 < Real.sqrt (b + c) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₆
  have h₁₁ : 0 < Real.sqrt (c + a) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₇
  
  -- Use Cauchy-Schwarz inequality in the form (∑ u_i v_i)² ≤ (∑ u_i²)(∑ v_i²)
  -- Set u_i = √(a/(a+b)), v_i = √a to get a lower bound

    -- Apply Cauchy-Schwarz: (∑ x_i y_i)² ≤ (∑ x_i²)(∑ y_i²)
    -- Let x_i = √(a/(a+b)), y_i = √a for each term
    -- Then ∑ x_i y_i = ∑ a/√(a+b) and ∑ x_i² = ∑ a/(a+b), ∑ y_i² = ∑ a
    -- By CS: (∑ a/√(a+b))² ≤ (∑ a/(a+b))(∑ a)
    -- Rearranging gives the desired form
    calc
      (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a)) ^ 2 ≥ 
        (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b + Real.sqrt c) ^ 2 / ((a + b) + (b + c) + (c + a)) := by sorry
      _ = (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b + Real.sqrt c) ^ 2 / ((a + b) + (b + c) + (c + a)) := by rfl
